
- A large statue of a masculine form: Clad in heavy armor and bearing a hammer with a small crackling circle in its center, this Aelarian has a pair of large demonic horns, and a pair of angelic wings.
	- The plaque beneath the statue reads: In memory of Tabbris, the wings of Thylor Aethil, may his soul rest within the weapon he forged. May he enjoy the 12 blessings of Daraan, the maker and ender of things, as he rests in glory for his final stand against the Betrayers. 
- A small statue of a strangely androgenous figure: Wearing robes of fine make and leaf like patterns on their garb, the figure strikes a strange stance on all fours, hunched backwards in a hissing motion like that of an animal. On their right arm is a gauntlet made of large scales.
	- The plaque beneath the statue reads: In honor of Nimue Olan, for her efforts against the invader Karegor, protection of the Oakenheart, and undying loyalty to the druids of Tena. May their roots grow deep and strong, and may they never forget the wielder of the Black Scales.
- A medium sized statue wearing a hooded set of robes, the skin is carved with tattoos of different Abyssal and Aelarian styles. His face, and all identifying features are smooth, as if his identity was removed.
	- The plaque beneath the statue reads: To the nameless, the carrier of the scripture, the ones who sacrifice themselves to carry the memory of the dead, we love you. Rovan, Tena, and many more shall never forget you. Until the Mother of Gods is born, and the new gods arise, praise be Daraan, for he is the maker of all things.
